intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (HC) Colle delle Finestre (177.5 km)

story: On the final mountain stage, a breakaway of over 30 riders, including Van Aert, gained ten minutes. In the peloton, Carapaz attacked with Del Toro following, before Yates bridged across and launched his own move. As his rivals hesitated, Yates built a decisive gap and took virtual race lead atop the Colle delle Finestre. He extended his advantage with help from Van Aert after the climb and secured the maglia rosa. Up front, Harper rode away from the break and won solo after a 32.5 km effort.
